english.title: Use a vehicle with a load not secured so as not to cause danger / nuisance on Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on part of Heathrow Airport to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF THE AIRPORT..), used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when the load carried by it was not so secured and in such a position that neither danger nor nuisance was caused or was likely to have been caused to a person or property by reason of

(A)_[the load or part thereof falling or being blown from]_
(B)_[movement of the load or part thereof in relation to]_

the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5.8(b) and 2.3 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
